title: Lower level golf games.
content: I went down an escalator into this huge open area, it was brightly lit with astroturf for the flooring. It was similar in size to those indoor golf driving range domes. For most part it was pretty open and barren. But against the sides they had these golf style games and or challenges. Flashing lights to attract you to come and play. One was possibly farthest drive, or highest pitch, best putt. At one of them the guy running it was dressed up as a clown. I didn't play as I was just walking and passing through. There were no other people there.
